title: Three Young Girls in Summer Outfits, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-20th-century black and white deckle-edged snapshot capturing three young girls posing outside a residential suburban house clad in horizontal siding. The children, tentatively identified on the reverse as Susie, Lynn, and Betty, wear patterned 1950s summer playsuits and sunsuits. The eldest girl on the right sports chic dark sunglasses and a gingham shorts outfit, exemplifying mid-century American childhood leisure and post-war suburban lifestyle.
